Passenger kicks alleged thief off moving train; passenger arrested

A video circulating online shows a passenger kicking an individual accused of theft off a speeding train in Chhattisgarh. The alleged thief fell from the moving train. Railway police have arrested the passenger who administered the kick and are investigating the incident.
